material_units.source_text: Semicontinuity. $f$ is lower semicontinuous if $f(x)\le\liminf_tf(x_t)$ whenever $x_t\to x$, equivalently if every $\{f\le c\}$ is closed; the Weierstrass argument still yields minima on nonempty compact sets. Example: $f=0$ on $(-\infty,0]$, $f=1$ on $(0,\infty)$ (Module 8).
